label: Bare number fact
description: The same addition presented with no concrete referents. Without objects to model, an abstract prompt like this tends to invite a non-counting strategy -- bridging through ten, a derived fact, or straight retrieval -- over counting-all/counting-on.
source: Carpenter, Fennema, Franke, Levi & Empson, Children's Mathematics: Cognitively Guided Instruction (2nd ed., 2014)
